reviews.decision: The two-file/six-hunk patch removes modern input/chip counters and introduces private _IdGenerator injection in their id field initializers with modern MDC prefixes. The legacy input and list retain their two original file-local counters and exact tagged initializer prefixes, with six interleaved extracted observations preserving independent sequences. The bare legacy chip has no id member in either source epoch; a modern chip id field would add an API and injection requirement. Current owned metadata and all inputs remain legacy, and no current chip parent or private ID/attribute-transform import is introduced. Preserve the independently owned historical counter behavior rather than adopting a private upstream surface or adding a modern control API. This is source and initializer protocol evidence only; component constructors, SSR/hydration, native/AOT/packed and floor matrices remain separate.
